records.title: SchwabEX-Guard Union authorisation cancelled at Sumitomo's own request, for business reasons
records.summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/2405, adopted under Article 49 BPR, records that Sumitomo Chemical Agro Europe SAS requested cancellation of EU-0025436-0000 on 21 March 2024, case BC-QP093655-06, and stated the request was made due to business reasons. Folded in: the product could no longer be made available from 3 April 2025 and existing stocks could not be used from 3 October 2025 under Article 52; the Iceland (03/04/2025), Norway (04/03/2025) and Switzerland (26/11/2024) entries ended earlier on separate EEA and Swiss timing not itemised in the act.

signal.label: Strong
signal.rationale: The only document in the file where a supporter states a position, and it is a withdrawal. Explicitly holder-initiated rather than regulatory action, which is what makes it read as commercial retreat rather than a safety event. It concerns one product, not the substance renewal.

sources.note: States the cancellation request and its stated reason outright.
